desc: The Springfield Armory® Model 2020 Heatseeker Pistol chambered in .308 blends bolt-action precision with AR-style modularity. Built on the custom-grade Model 2020 action with dual locking lugs and EDM raceways, it is housed in a lightweight Sharps Bros. Heatseeker Chassis finished in Graphite Black Cerakote®. The pistol is rounded out with a rear-mounted rail section and B5 Systems P5 grip offering exceptional versatility and performance.
